scope: Personal Codex skill; no repository product addition or global policy edit
authorization: User requested implementation and iteration until satisfactory quality; announced initial maximum 24 live model dispatches
design: 8 unseen synthetic workflow cases paired baseline/candidate; 4 candidate-only near misses; single repetition. Candidate available through native discovery, not prompt inlining. Existing Korean editor available in both arms.
environment: macOS; isolated HOME/CODEX_HOME per call; memories disabled; only target and editor user skills; no superpowers; read-only synthetic repository
primary_gate: All candidate positive cases preserve every material invariant, output format and source scope. No workspace mutation or invented validation. Any failure requires correction and separate held-out verification before installation. No superiority claim if baseline also passes.
discovery_gate: 8/8 candidate positives read SKILL.md and appropriate reference; 0/4 near misses read candidate. Inspect completed command output, not mentions alone.
grading: Author reviews every response against frozen invariants and tool evidence. JSON and workspace checks deterministic; semantic judgment not independent or human comprehension evidence. No LLM judge disguised as independent.
secondary: Per-case duration, tokens, output length and unnecessary prose; descriptive only, not cross-model or statistical conclusions.
stop: Stop on passing stated gates; keep failures and unavailable runs visible. At 24 calls report remaining limitations rather than repeating until a pass.
